scripts.package: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const cmds=process.platform==='win32'?['python','py','python3']:['python3','python']; for (const cmd of cmds) { const probe=spawnSync(cmd,['-c','import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info[0]>=3 else 1)'],{stdio:'ignore'}); if (probe.status===0) { const run=spawnSync(cmd,['scripts/package.py'],{stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(run.status==null?1:run.status); } } console.error('Python 3 is required (python3 or python).'); process.exit(1);"
